findings.summary: sort looks names up among all of the model's fields instead of the allowed ones, so a client can sort on a field the view did not list, such as a password hash, and learn its values from the order.
max_per_page only caps the default page size, so a client-supplied per_page is used as given and can fetch any number of rows.
The lte operator maps to operator.lt, so __lte excludes rows equal to the value.
isnull passes the string to is_null, and the string 'false' is truthy, so __isnull=false selects the rows that are null.
_positive only rejects 0, so a negative per_page gets through. min() keeps it below max_per_page and SQLite treats LIMIT -1 as no limit, so a client can fetch every row.
